title: Data extension
description: The `org.opord-builder.data` extension: variables that a `${var}` or `${var/json/pointer}` binding in any string of the document reads. The group is resolved and removed when the document is loaded.

vars.description: Variable name -> source. Each variable has exactly one of `path`, `from` or `value`, and optionally the selectors `select`, `where`, `key` and `map`, applied in that order.

path.description: A file, relative to this document (absolute is allowed). A path with glob characters (`*`, `?`, `[`) matches files in sorted order; each is parsed and `select`ed, then the results are combined (lists concatenate, maps merge, a duplicate key is an error).

format.description: The file format when the suffix (`.json`, `.yaml`, `.yml`, `.csv`) does not say.

validate.description: `openaix`: load the file as an OpenAIX document, bindings included.

from.description: One variable, or several that are combined in order (lists concatenate, maps merge, a duplicate key is an error).

value.description: A literal JSON value; it is not interpolated.

select.description: A JSON Pointer into the value; a missing pointer is an error.

where.description: JSON Pointer -> value; keeps the items (of a list) or entries (of a map) that equal all of them.

key.description: A JSON Pointer in each item of a list; turns the list into a map keyed by that value as text.

map.description: A JSON Pointer (project each item to that sub-value) or field -> JSON Pointer (project each item to a record).
